title: 💻 Mission 1 — Agent ID Generator
subtitle: Create a formatted Morpheus agent identification code.
instructions:
Replace each "____" with the correct variable: name, team, agent_number or agent_id.

Your Agent ID must use the order: name-team-agent number.
starterCode:
# AGENT ID GENERATOR - Morpheus Security Systems

# Step 1: Collect user input
name = input("Enter your first name: ")
team = input("Enter your team: ")
agent_number = input("Enter a 3-digit number: ")

# Step 2: Build the Agent ID
# Replace each "____" with the correct variable (name, team, or agent_number)
agent_id = "____" + "-" + "____" + "-" + "____"

# Step 3: Display the result
print("=== MORPHEUS SECURITY SYSTEMS ===")
print("Agent ID:", "____")
print("Status: ACTIVE")
hints: The required order for the Agent ID is name, team, then agent_number.
Remove the quotation marks around each blank. You want Python to use the value stored in the variable, not the text "____".
The blank in Step 3 should be replaced with the agent_id variable.

codeChecks.message: Build the Agent ID using name, team and agent_number in that order.
In Step 3, print the agent_id variable instead of the blank.

successMessage: Agent ID complete! Run your program and check that it displays your name, team and agent number correctly.
